# League Record S1 pilot: the A.J. Brown / HammerTime lineage

**Status:** draft evidence, generated by `node scripts/league_record/s1/run_pilot.mjs` from committed sources only. Read-only: no D1, no Worker route, no model call, no production write. Franchise ids and team names only; every statement is about a franchise, never an owner (`owner_identity: not_asserted`).

**Classes used everywhere:** CONFIRMED (a recorded MFL event states it) · CALCULATED (code arithmetic over recorded inputs) · INFERRED (a named rule with all its conditions met; never confirmed) · UNRESOLVED (incomplete or competing evidence; a candidate may be listed and counts for nothing).

**Sources:** archive `data/db-archives/mfl_database_2026-06-05.db.gz` (sha256 `2b344b794422a64e...`, tables read: transactions_trades, transactions_base, transactions_adddrop, draftresults_mfl, draftresults_legacy, rosters_weekly, playerscores_weekly, player_weeklyscoringresults, leagueevents, players, transactions_auction, metadata_franchise) and the committed daily snapshot `data/mfl-snapshots/2026-11-19` (transactions.json, draftResults.json, rosters.json, league.json, _snapshot_meta.json).

## 1. What happened, from HammerTime's side (confirmed view)

1. **The upstream trade (trade2024_30 on 2024-07-24 08:51:24 (archive table transactions_trades, group trade2024_30)):** In trade2024_30 (2024-07-24) 0005 sent McCaffrey, Christian and received Brown, A.J.: a one-for-one exchange, so the transaction itself pairs them.
2. **Brown's production for 0005:** 239.1 verified points in 13 scored weeks (239.1 while started) in 2024. Weeks without a scoring row (2, 3, 4, 5) carry no points; none was filled with zero.
3. **Salary he carried:** 19,000 for 2024 on a BL contract (2 year(s) remaining; recorded text `CL 2| TCV 92K| AAV 46K|Y1-19 Y2-73 | Ext: Sex, Creel`); the first 2025 weekly roster record for franchise 0006 shows 73,000. Two roster records show two amounts; the contract text changes between them, so this is not proof that one obligation carried over unchanged.
4. **The Brown trade (trade2025_5 on 2025-03-05 13:18:22 (archive table transactions_trades, group trade2025_5)), one package:** In trade2025_5 (2025-03-05) 0005 sent Brown, A.J., 20,000 in cap money and received 2025 round 1, slot 8 (pick 1.08), 2026 round 3 pick, original franchise 0006, in one transaction. The record states no allocation among these assets, so no single asset is credited with any part of what was received. The two picks and the cap money are the whole of what came back in that one transaction; the record does not say how much of it was Brown's price, and no part is credited to Brown alone.
5. **The 2025 pick** (slot 8, MFL's own slot token) was one of the two picks 0005 received in the Brown package. 0005 used it on 2025-05-25: Judkins, Quinshon, CONFIRMED by the MFL draft result for that slot (a pick being selected is draft identity, not trade value). The **2026 round 3 pick**, the other incoming pick, was traded again and came home to its original franchise; its slot is UNRESOLVED (section 5).
6. **Judkins was traded in a package** In trade2025_34 (2025-08-07) 0005 sent Judkins, Quinshon and received Sinnott, Ben, 2026 round 2 pick, original franchise 0010, 2026 round 2 pick, original franchise 0007, in one transaction. The record states no allocation among these assets, so no single asset is credited with any part of what was received. Both 2026 round 2 picks that arrived in that package later left in further packages: In trade2025_53 (2025-10-03) 0005 sent Conner, James, 2026 round 2 pick, original franchise 0010, 2026 round 4 pick, original franchise 0005 and received Swift, D'Andre, 11,000 in cap money, in one transaction. The record states no allocation among these assets, so no single asset is credited with any part of what was received. In trade2025_72 (2025-11-25) 0005 sent Strange, Brenton, 2026 round 2 pick, original franchise 0008, 2026 round 2 pick, original franchise 0007 and received Stroud, C.J., in one transaction. The record states no allocation among these assets, so no single asset is credited with any part of what was received. A pick that was part of such a package is said to have been included in it; it is never said to have become the player received.
7. **Total of verified points for the traced player possession periods of 0005:** 662.6 (57 scored weeks; 535.1 while started). It adds up every traced player's verified points while 0005 held him. It is **not** a net gain, and not the return on the Brown transaction: those players arrived in packages with other assets, and no player's production or value is allocated to any one outgoing asset. INFERRED and UNRESOLVED links contribute nothing to it.

## 2. Every traced asset, with its generation and class

Generation 0 is the upstream trade and Brown. Each trade of a traced asset by 0005 adds the assets 0005 received in that SAME transaction as the next generation: they are traced because they took part in the package, not because the asset sent "became" them (see the package rule below). A pick that is selected adds the drafted player as one more generation. Limit: generation 4.

**Package rule:** A trade is one transaction: everything a franchise surrendered was exchanged for everything it received. The record states no allocation among the assets, so (1) DIRECT CONSIDERATION is the whole incoming set for the whole outgoing set, (2) LINEAGE PARTICIPATION only says a traced asset took part, and (3) ATTRIBUTABLE ECONOMIC RETURN is established only for an exact one-for-one exchange with no cap money; otherwise nothing is credited to any single asset (scripts/league_record/s1/packages.mjs).

- **salary_horizon**: weekly roster contracts end with the 2025 season; 2026 contracts are shown only from the latest daily roster snapshot, as recorded on that day
- **team_cap_totals_not_computed**: per-player salary and the recorded cap transfers are shown; a franchise's total cap position on a date needs the full roster and adjustment record (League Record slice S2)
- **owner_identity_not_asserted**: every statement is about a franchise id; franchise continuity is not owner continuity (League Record slice S3)

Annual stretches with no recorded transaction of any kind that overlap the traced chains (data-driven, 14 days or more): 2024-12-31 to 2025-02-17; 2025-03-27 to 2025-04-25; 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-30; 2025-07-02 to 2025-07-15; 2025-11-28 to 2026-03-07. A chain is only as complete as the periods around its records.

**Generation limit:** 4. Untraced continuations at the limit: none. Companion assets that travelled in the same trades are listed in section 3 and not traced.

## 8. Acceptance tests T1-T17

| Test | Result | What it proves |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | PASS | every asset, link and event carries a class and a source reference (nodes, events, possession periods, breaks, trade legs, cap entries, transfers, departures, points, contracts) |
| T2 | PASS | every trade in the bundle equals its raw archive rows or snapshot entry, checked by a separate code path |
| T3 | PASS | every transaction keeps its date, time, date quality, asset identity and both franchise ids |
| T4 | PASS | every chain replays the recorded trades; every discontinuity is listed, none is filled |
| T5 | PASS | every slot comes from an MFL slot token and the MFL draft result for that slot; a future pick is never confirmed to a slot |
| T6 | PASS | uniqueness infers only when the holder owns one slot AND the round's inventory is demonstrably complete AND custody is observed to the evidence date (INFERRED, labeled); two slots, an incomplete or disagreeing inventory, an unobserved period or no evidence stay UNRESOLVED |
| T7 | PASS | no owner field or owner name anywhere; every statement is about a franchise id |
| T8 | PASS | possession periods come from trade, draft and add or drop events; weekly-roster disagreements are listed, not used |
| T9 | PASS | the build fails if the extraction reads any ranking or forecast data (draft slots come only from MFL draft results, slot tokens and slot lists): the runtime table guard and the static source scan are both clean |
| T10 | PASS | points are per franchise and per possession, copy weeks are excluded, disputed weeks are not verified, and an INFERRED asset never enters a confirmed-only total |
| T11 | PASS | every salary and contract shown equals the recorded weekly roster row; none is estimated; team cap totals are explicitly not computed |
| T12 | PASS | the trace stops at the stated generation limit and every untraced continuation is listed on the frontier |
| T13 | PASS | the 2025-11-28 to 2026-03-07 trade-coverage gap is on the list and is shown on every chain (player or pick) that crosses it; no pick whose custody crosses it is resolved; every chain break is a listed gap |
| T14 | PASS | two builds are byte-identical and match the committed bundle; the archive opens read-only; no extraction module contains a network call pattern (fetch, http, net, WebSocket) |
| T15 | PASS | only franchise ids, team names and player names appear; no owner column is read; no email, credential or chat text |
| T16 | external | independent review (Codex) on the exact head, and CI on the head and on the merge result of the head with the base, both SHAs named: recorded on the pull request, not asserted by this file |
| T17 | PASS | every trade is kept as one package with every asset and cap amount in its direction; lineage participation is separate from attributable return, which is established only for an exact one-for-one exchange; no number sits under an attribution field |
